sim.pastMod: Deeper than the MOD for this mix
sim.calcIntro: Choose a mix and a PPO2 limit, then follow the calculation.
sim.step1: Find the absolute pressure at which this mix reaches the limit: divide the limit by the oxygen fraction.
sim.step2: Subtract the 1 ata of atmosphere to get the pressure due to water alone.
sim.step3: Convert pressure to depth: each {{perAtm}} {{unit}} of seawater adds 1 ata.
sim.step4: Round down to the whole {{unit}}. The MOD is a ceiling, never a target.

about.title: About Nitrox Academy
about.whatBody: An independent, interactive way to understand Enriched Air Nitrox theory: pressure, partial pressure, oxygen limits, MOD, gas analysis and planning. It is built to make the physics intuitive before you sit a certification course and exam.
about.not1: Not a certification. Completing anything here does not qualify you to dive with enriched air. Only a recognized training agency can certify you, and that includes in-person practical training.
about.not2: Not a dive computer or planning tool. Every calculator here is for learning. Plan real dives with your training, your computer and your buddy.
about.not3: Not affiliated with PADI, SSI, RAID, SDI/TDI, NAUI, NOAA, DAN or any other organization. Names are used only to describe publicly known standards.
about.scienceBody: Calculations use the standard dive-planning conventions (10 msw or 33 fsw per atmosphere, Dalton's law, the MOD and EAD formulas) and the NOAA oxygen exposure limits. Every formula is covered by automated tests with independently derived reference values. Planning limits such as 1.4 and 1.6 ata are training-agency conventions and are labelled as such wherever they appear.
about.reviewBody: The content has not yet been reviewed by a certified diving instructor. Until it is, treat it as a study aid and defer to your instructor and agency materials where they differ.
about.privacyBody: All progress lives in your browser. There are no accounts, no tracking and no servers.
about.creditBody: Nitrox Academy is created and maintained by Guy Eden.

legal.title: Before you start
legal.intro: Nitrox Academy is a free, independent study tool. Its material is drawn from published professional sources: the NOAA Diving Manual oxygen exposure limits, Divers Alert Network (DAN) publications, public training-agency materials (BSAC, RAID, PADI, SDI), industry standards (CGA G-4.1, EN 144-3) and peer-reviewed studies, all listed on the About page. Every formula is checked automatically against reference values.
legal.p1: It is a study aid, not a certification and not a substitute for a Nitrox course with a certified instructor.
legal.p2: The calculators and simulators exist to build understanding. They are not a dive computer and not a dive plan.
legal.p3: Every dive is planned and carried out at the diver's own responsibility, according to their training, their equipment, their dive computer and their agency's standards.
legal.p4: This site is provided free of charge and as is, without warranty of any kind. Its operators accept no liability for any loss, injury or damage arising from use of the information in it. The responsibility is yours.
legal.accept: I understand. The responsibility is mine
legal.sourcesIntro: The content is original and is based on the following published sources:
sources: NOAA Diving Manual: oxygen exposure limits and Nitrox conventions.
Divers Alert Network (DAN): oxygen toxicity, maximum operating depth and oxygen-cleaning articles.
Public training-agency materials: BSAC Nitrox workbook, RAID, PADI and SDI course descriptions.
Industry standards: CGA G-4.1 (oxygen service), EN 144-3 (Nitrox valves).
Peer-reviewed studies: Donald 1947 (oxygen poisoning), Harris et al. 2003 and Chapman & Plato 2008 (fatigue), Hesser et al. 1978 (narcosis).
Standard dive-planning formulas (pressure, Dalton's law, MOD, EAD, OTU) as published in training materials.
legal.liability: Nitrox Academy is a free educational website. It does not certify divers, it is not a dive computer, and it is not affiliated with any training agency or standards body. All diving decisions and their consequences are the sole responsibility of the diver. The site and its operators accept no liability whatsoever for injury, loss or damage connected to its use. Where this site and your instructor, agency or dive computer differ, follow them.
legal.footer: Free educational site. Use at your own responsibility; not a certification.
